---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem in FLIP for macOS
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---
Describe the problem and what you expected.

Include:
- macOS version and chip (e.g., macOS 15.x / 26.x / 27.x, Apple Silicon)
- FLIP version (`flip --version`)
- Input and output formats (or New File kind)
- Trigger used (`DownArrow`, custom key, Mouse Button `2`/`3`/`4`, `Option+Shift+Space`, Quick Action, or CLI) and whether the key was pressed before or during the Finder drag
- Accessibility / Input Monitoring / Finder Automation permission status

List the steps to reproduce and how many files were selected in Finder.
Remove personal filenames, paths, and document content from screenshots and logs before sharing them (use **Copy Diagnostics** for automatic path redaction).
